general.source_text: The degree overview lists Global Management as a 24-month on-campus master's program starting in September, located in Berlin with required global internship and social impact projects.

General requirements include a Bachelor's-equivalent degree with excellent grades, no more than 24 months postgraduate work experience, conditional English scores, conditional BAT/GMAT/GRE, essays, one reference, and EUR 75 fee.

key_findings: ESMT has three MSc master's programs: Global Management, Innovation and Entrepreneurship, and Analytics and Artificial Intelligence.
For the MSc programs, English tests are conditional rather than automatically mandatory; if required, the reviewed pages expect TOEFL 100, IELTS 7.0, or TOEIC 850.

For the MSc programs, BAT/GMAT/GRE is also conditional and can be waived when transcripts or related qualifications show sufficient quantitative skills; low guideline scores are GMAT below 600 and GRE below 304.
The Full-time MBA has a different English threshold set: TOEFL 95, PTE 64, or IELTS 7 if applicable, and requires at least three years of postgraduate professional experience.
The Global Online MBA, Part-time MBA, and Executive MBA are included from official MBA program pages, but their detailed admissions subpages were not fully extracted here.
known_gaps: Detailed admissions pages for Global Online MBA, Part-time MBA, and Executive MBA are referenced by official pages but were not in the assigned seed/source URL set; those three records are marked for human review.
The PhD program appears in ESMT navigation but was not covered by the assigned admissions seed/source URLs and is not included as a program record.
Exact English-test validity periods for ESMT programs were not found in the reviewed page text.
Tuition and scholarship details were not exhaustively extracted; only visible application fees or visible MBA tuition figures were captured.
